WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescopes
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.powerstatus,
    sc.telescope_count,
    tt.total_count,
    (sc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / tt.total_count) * 100 as share_pct
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_pct) as avg_share_pct
  FROM status_shares
),
above_average_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.powerstatus,
    ss.telescope_count,
    ss.share_pct,
    asc.avg_share_pct,
    ss.share_pct - asc.avg_share_pct as excess
  FROM status_shares ss
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE ss.share_pct > asc.avg_share_pct
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(share_pct) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess_above_average
FROM above_average_statuses
